bites.title: Seamless, on purpose
bites.body: Game textures repeat. Wrap-around mode tiles your canvas infinitely while you paint, so seams show up while you can still fix them.

bites.title: Turn it on
bites.body: Press {key:wrap_around_mode|Shift+W}. Zoom out ({key:view_zoom_out|-}) to see the tiles.

bites.title: Paint across the seams
bites.body: Twenty marks: bricks, leaves, scales, anything. Paint right across the edges; they wrap to the other side.

bites.title: Turn it off
bites.body: Shift+W again. Your texture tiles perfectly in any game engine.

bites.title: 22 cleared
bites.body: Wrap-around, paint the seams, export. That's a game-ready texture.
